Q: Publishing with Web Deploy causes Asp.Net Web Forms application to start and stop multiple times A:

Almost 5 years later, I found the solution (this problem never stopped bugging me).
In IIS, there are 2 settings that may affect application restarts and cause an application to stop/start more than once:

  1. Overlapped process recycling: this feature may cause this behavior. Can be turned off in the app pool via "YourAppPool --> Advanced settings --> Scroll to bottom section "Recycling" --> Disable overlapped recycling".

Q: ICEBERG_FILESYSTEM_ERROR: Cannot create a table on a non-empty location A:

Use the below syntax:

DROP TABLE my_table;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE my_table WITH (
  is_external = false,
  location = 's3://my_bucket/my_table',
  table_type='iceberg',
  vacuum_max_snapshot_age_seconds=3600
  write_compression='ZSTD',
  format='PARQUET'
)
AS
SELECT * from my_backup_table;

Q: What's the difference between df.iloc[:,1:2].values and df.iloc[:,1].values in pandas? A:

The difference is that with dataset.iloc[:,1:2] you will get a DataFrame and with dataset.iloc[:,-1] you will get a Series. When you use the attribute values with a DataFrame you get a 2d ndarray and with a Series you get a 1d ndarray. Consider the following example:

   A  B  C
0  0  2  0
1  1  0  0
2  1  2  1

Series:

type(df.iloc[:, -1])
# pandas.core.series.Series

df.iloc[:, -1].values.shape
# (3,)

DataFrame:

type(df.iloc[:, -1:])
# pandas.core.frame.DataFrame

df.iloc[:, -1:].values.shape
# (3, 1)

It's a common trick in machine learning to get a target variable as 2d ndarray in one step.
